Also, buy lots (or better yet, find them) tools. You can then save your iron and copper and timber and just use the duplicates to refine the tools (which increases yield while using them. So one copper spot will yield 4 or 5 instead of 2). 

Same can be done for weapons but I think its huge for tools as they are cheap. 

Lv1 pickaxe can be upgraded with another lv 1 . Lv2 with a lv 2 etc
